items.title: Blessings Note Jar
items.alt: A clear jar labeled “BLESSINGS” holds folded pastel notes beside its wooden lid, a pencil and two heart-shaped papers.
items.description: A small pink-heart-and-leaf border decorates the cream label, leaving the colored notes visible through the glass.

items.title: Blessings Reflection Tag Tree
items.alt: A wooden display tree holds blank heart, leaf and star tags above a base marked “BLESSINGS.”
items.description: Six hanging shapes form balanced branches, each with a pale center and a colored border for personal notes.

items.title: Community Blessing Box Pantry
items.alt: An open green-roofed pantry marked “BLESSING BOX” displays unbranded tins, food boxes and bread rolls.
items.description: Two clear-front doors swing outward from the cream cabinet above its complete green support post.

items.title: Blessings Bread and Apple Gift Basket
items.alt: A cloth-lined wicker basket holds bread rolls, apples and a red preserve jar with a “BLESSINGS” gift tag.
items.description: A red-striped tea towel crosses the cream lining beneath the jar’s checked lid and tied cord.

items.title: Blessed Cross and Lily Keepsake
items.alt: A gold Christian cross stands between white lilies above a burgundy ribbon reading “BLESSED.”
items.description: Polished beveled edges and a complete oval pedestal give the floral devotional object a formal, freestanding shape.

items.title: Ceramic Doves with a Blank Heart Tag
items.alt: Two blue-grey and ivory ceramic doves perch on a curved branch above a blank cream heart tag.
items.description: One bird tilts its head toward the other, while small gold-colored loops suspend the heart below the complete branch.
